content.short: Sociogram is a multichain SocialFi that connects Web3 projects and creators with real users.
content.description: Sociogram offers a social platform where users can chat, host giveaways, and promote content, all without being limited by restrictive algorithms or the threat of shadow bans. It targets three persistent challenges in the Web3 space: bot-driven activity that skews engagement, the limited effectiveness of traditional DeFi advertising, and the absence of robust, strategic partnerships within Web3 ecosystems. By removing algorithmic restrictions and shadow bans, the platform emphasizes user conversations, promotional activity, and content visibility within Web3 networks.
